day_shape: 83 items: Trump confirms US-Iran talks in Doha with Witkoff and Kushner, heavy regime cycle on Khamenei funeral logistics with 30+ countries claimed attending, IDF seals 16km Rafah tunnel with 30,000m³ concrete, Rubio-Wadephul meeting on Hormuz, nothing from UK Parliament or IAEA.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral preparations
threads.summary: Iranian state outlets detailed logistics for the supreme leader's funeral, with Defa Press claiming over 30 countries have indicated attendance and 100,000 youth volunteers mobilised. Iran International reported public criticism of the July 4-9 schedule and organised turnout efforts, while noting security planning to avoid past crowd-crush disasters.

threads.label: US-Iran Doha talks scheduled
threads.summary: Trump announced US-Iran talks in Doha with Witkoff and Kushner attending, following a Rubio-Witkoff congressional briefing on the signed Memorandum of Understanding. House Minority Leader Jeffries called for a full unclassified briefing, while Iran International reported flare-ups narrowing diplomatic space.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and ceasefire posture
threads.summary: Iran's acting Defence Minister Sardar Ibn al-Reza told Qatar's State Minister for Defence that any ceasefire violation would draw a proportionate response, while parliament's security commission head claimed sole Iranian sovereignty over the Strait. Rubio and German FM Wadephul reiterated commitment to safe Hormuz transit and preventing an Iranian nuclear weapon.

threads.label: Israel-Lebanon framework and operations
threads.summary: Defence Minister Katz said the IDF will only partially withdraw from southern Lebanon pending Hezbollah disarmament, as CENTCOM commander Adm. Cooper met President Aoun on implementing the Washington framework signed Friday. An IDF reservist was severely wounded by a blast in Arnoun, and Magos Systems secured a NIS 21 million radar deal for the border.

threads.label: Gaza tunnel strikes and Hamas commanders
threads.summary: The IDF announced sealing a 16km Hamas tunnel in Rafah where Lt. Hadar Goldin's remains were held, using over 30,000 cubic metres of concrete, and struck a Deir al-Balah underground site Hamas was rebuilding. The IDF and Shin Bet also confirmed killing Ismail Masri, Hamas's Rafah Brigade military security chief.

threads.label: Western Iran unrest and IRGC questions
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported several Iranian security personnel killed in clashes across western Iran, and Defa Press confirmed two IRGC guards from Paveh killed in what it called a terrorist operation. Officials clashed over an alleged Mossad plan to arm Kurds, while Iran International examined establishment talk of restructuring the IRGC.

threads.label: Iran domestic strain
threads.summary: Iran International reported nearly half of Iranians live in land-subsidence zones per parliamentary researchers cited by Shargh, and a wildfire in Zagros forests near Behbahan entered a fourth day. State media reported Kerman office closures over air pollution and unresolved Evin prison escapes.

events.title: Citizens tell Iran football team it lost the public long ago
events.summary: Iran's elimination from the FIFA World Cup prompted a wave of public reactions, with many citizens arguing the team's defeat reflected the political positions of some players rather than simply a sporting failure, according to messages sent to Iran International.
